record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.original_question: Consider compact aspherical 4-manifolds with boundary in the setting where the Borel conjecture for pairs is valid by topological surgery, namely when the common fundamental group pi = pi1(M0) is good, for example elementary amenable. Which good groups pi occur as fundamental groups of compact aspherical 4-manifolds?

evidence.quote: By topological surgery, the Borel Conjecture is valid when the fundamental group pi = pi1(M0) is good, for example, if pi is elementary amenable. One now proceeds to the following three problems: 1. Decide which good pi are the fundamental groups of compact aspherical 4-manifolds.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A topological space $X$ is called aspherical if $\pi_n(X)=0$ for all $n\geq 2$. A discrete group $\pi$ is called good (in the sense of Freedman) if the 5-dimensional topological surgery sequence is exact for manifolds with fundamental group $\pi$; for instance, every elementary amenable group is good. 

Problem: Characterize all good groups $\pi$ that arise as fundamental groups of compact aspherical topological 4-manifolds (possibly with boundary). Equivalently, give necessary and sufficient algebraic/cohomological conditions on a good group $\pi$ for the existence of a compact aspherical 4-manifold $M$ with $\pi_1(M)\cong \pi$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of classifying which good (e.g. elementary amenable) groups arise as fundamental groups of compact aspherical 4-manifolds remains open. Recent works (e.g. Hillman, and 2025 arXiv preprints on the Borel Conjecture for manifolds with boundary) treat partial classifications—particularly for elementary amenable fundamental groups and under additional cohomological hypotheses—but a complete characterization is not available.

status_evidence.title: Borel Conjecture for compact aspherical 4-manifolds - Manifold Atlas
status_evidence.snippet: The Borel Conjecture holds for 4-manifolds with good fundamental group by topological surgery.
status_evidence.claim: The Borel conjecture in dimension 4 is known under the good-group hypothesis, but the realization question for such groups as fundamental groups of compact aspherical 4-manifolds is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The Borel Conjecture for manifolds with boundary
status_evidence.snippet: If π is the fundamental group of a compact aspherical 4-manifold and π is elementary amenable, then the Farrell-Jones Conjecture holds...
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work establishes uniqueness/Borel-type results under elementary amenable hypotheses but does not give a full classification of good groups occurring as such fundamental groups.
